name: Dr. Martha Pleitez
bio: Dr. Martha Pleitez is the warm, compassionate heart of Pleitez Dental Corp. Patients consistently describe her as caring, professional, and genuinely invested in their well-being — checking in throughout every procedure and making even nervous patients feel completely at ease. With a focus on family dental care and patient education, Dr. Martha ensures that every visit to Pleitez Dental Corp feels like a visit with someone who truly cares about your health.
